meta.title: Word Counter — Count Words, Characters, and Sentences
meta.description: Free online word counter. Instantly count words, characters, sentences, and paragraphs in your text. Perfect for essays, articles, and social media.

howItWorks: Type or paste your text into the input area.
The tool counts words, characters (with and without spaces), sentences, and paragraphs in real time.
Counts update automatically as you edit your text.
howToUse: Paste or type your text in the text area.
View the word count, character count, sentence count, and paragraph count below.
Use the counts for essays, articles, social media posts, or any text-based work.

faq.question: Does the word counter work offline?
faq.answer: Yes. Once the page is loaded, all counting happens in your browser. No internet connection is needed.

faq.question: Is my text stored or sent anywhere?
faq.answer: No. Your text is processed entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded to a server or stored.

faq.question: How are sentences counted?
faq.answer: Sentences are counted by detecting sentence-ending punctuation (periods, exclamation marks, question marks) followed by a space or line break.

examples.title: Count words in a paragraph
examples.description: Paste a paragraph to see word and character counts.
examples.input: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog."
